svg.title: Far-field equipotentials of −4q and +q
svg.desc: Seen from far away, the charges −4q and +q, drawn as a tiny pair at the centre, act like a single charge −3q. Computed equipotentials at equal potential steps, −1, −2, −3, and −4 units, are circles centred on the pair at radii in the ratio 1 : 1/2 : 1/3 : 1/4, so the gaps between neighbouring circles grow with distance (roughly as r squared). The potential is negative and increases outward, toward zero at infinity.
